headline: Weathered Expanse Front Erupts Again
war_summary: The latest returns mark a sharp change from the preceding quiet spell. WeatheredExpanseHex has surged from 51 to 62 strategic-base events in the past day, with 13 in the latest two hours alone; its ledger now stands at four Warden, three Colonial, and two unclaimed bases. StlicanShelfHex has also quickened, rising from 18 to 23 daily events and recording two in the latest two hours. FishermansRowHex remains unsettled at 33 daily events, though its latest two-hour count has eased to one; six Colonial, three Warden, and no unclaimed bases are reported. CallahansPassageHex has slipped from 31 to 29 daily events and shows no fresh movement in two hours, while MooringCountyHex holds at 12 events with its recent ledger likewise quiet. NevishLineHex, previously a lesser concern, has five daily events and one in the latest two hours amid sharply rising casualty and enlistment rates. LinnMercyHex remains comparatively still, with three daily events and no new movement. The heaviest records therefore lie in Weathered Expanse and Stlican Shelf, while several older hot spots have cooled.
